newsitem.title: CANADA: Ventra raises offer for Tarxien.
newsitem.headline: Ventra raises offer for Tarxien.

text.p: Ventra Group Inc said it raised its offer for shares of Tarxien Corp to C$9.25 a share in cash plus two common shares of Ventra, plus one warrant and the right to an extra C$0.95 in cash or an extra half of one Ventra share.
The warrant will entitle the holder to purchase one Ventra common share for C$2.60 on or before the second anniversary of the expiry date of the offer.
Ventra said in a statement that it had lock-up agreements to acquire 50.3 percent of Tarxien shares.
